sections.heading: Peer 来源、短启动与 bootstrap

blocks.text: createProcessPeer 的 spawn/connect/listen 必须恰选一种；由本包 launcher 启动的子进程才可省略来源，通过已有发现标记与 stdin bootstrap 连回父进程。直接 node service.js 不满足此前提，应显式 listen。provide 默认无业务方法，只接受自身可枚举数据属性与嵌套方法组；点分路径如 math.double，getter、循环、重复路径和非法名字在连接前拒绝。普通函数用于 request/notify，iterable/async iterable 用 stream；payload/结果仍受 Core 可移植值契约约束。

blocks.text: 双方可 provide 并反向调用。子进程 Peer 会保持事件循环直到父连接关闭；正常 parent-loss 路径处理子进程退出，但强杀父进程时无法承诺父端清理已执行，更不能保证孙进程都终止。
短 spawn 接受 true、入口字符串/URL 或普通对象。true 重跑当前主入口全部顶层代码，必须先 isProcessChild 分支，避免无限自派生；该函数只读既有 bootstrap 标记，发现阶段消费标记后仍为 true，不代替认证。REPL/eval/test runner、Electron 和无可用主入口的单文件程序不支持自派生，应给精确入口或显式 command/args。

blocks.text: Node/Bun 保留 runtime flags 与 --import loader，移除 eval/print/test 控制参数。Node 原生类型剥离不把 .js import 改成 .ts；这类源码使用构建后的 JS 或实际 loader，Bun 可解析其支持的 TS 导入。Deno 默认 run 仅给 PATH 与 bootstrap 标记所需 env 权限，额外权限用显式 command/args。不要把自己测试运行器的主入口当作可派生业务入口。
PROCESS_RUNTIME_API_ENV 的公开值为 MIGAIA_RPC_RUNTIME_API_BOOTSTRAP，版本标记为 '1'；它是发现信息，不是 secret。实际 bootstrap 先读 4 字节大端长度和对应内容，独立元数据封套不改变 RPC 握手语法；运行时 bootstrap 等待默认 10000 ms，之后才进入原握手截止。

Node launcher 不开 shell，只传显式环境，先开始 stderr drain 再写 bootstrap，stdout channel 不再被普通输出消费者抢读。Node 声明 fault isolation 与 stdin bootstrap enforced，但 termination、内存/CPU/permissions/fd bootstrap 不作 enforced 保证；POSIX 可尝试进程组终止，Windows 尽力停止直接子进程，均不能承诺整树必定终止。required isolation 不能当作 Node best-effort 的别名。

短来源 spawn.supervision.startupTimeoutMs 默认 10000；restart 内平铺 mode:'on-failure'、maxRestarts:5、windowMs:60000、initialDelayMs:250、factor:2、maxDelayMs:30000；stop.drainTimeoutMs/stop.reapTimeoutMs 默认均 5000。restart.mode 仅 never/on-failure/always，分别不重启、失败重启、退出后始终重启。Process managed binding 另复用 Core 5000 ms 调用 drain，并受 stop 剩余预算收窄，不保证无限等待全部不合作调用。
短来源省略 report 时，同一原生进程最多合并报告一次预期 termination unsupported 提示；显式 report 每次启动都收到，直接传默认函数与包装它没有差异。onNotice 可替代该项 reporter 调用。其它错误照常报告，完整来源保持其显式 reporter 语义。
wrap(command) 每次首次启动、restart、replace 都执行，接收并仅能返回 command、args、cwd、env；自定义 launcher 同样经过它。macOS 可由应用选择 sandbox-exec/profile，Linux 可选择 bwrap/只读挂载与隔离网络；本包不安装工具、不维护沙箱策略，也不把这些平台示意当作已执行验证。

包装器必须透传 stdin/stdout：stdin 先承载 token/bootstrap，再承载 RPC，stdout 只能是协议帧，日志写 stderr。保留 env.inherit/env.set；launcher 在 wrap 后加入 MIGAIA_RPC_RUNTIME_API_BOOTSTRAP，容器包装还需转入此变量与原环境。原退出码必须保留，不能把非零改成成功。wrap 返回的 stdio/bootstrap/limits/permissions 额外字段不授予更改这些资源的权限。
非函数 wrap 在准备阶段拒绝；回调抛错或非法返回使启动失败，PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION TypeError 位于 supervision LAUNCH_FAILED 的 cause 链，回调原值保留 cause。Host 安装最外层仍可为 PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED，不按 message 判断。

完整 spawn 对象显式组合 kind:'spawn'、channelKind:'byte'|'message'、supervision、rawChannel(handle,signal)、establish(raw,prepared)、token 与可选 offer。完整 byte spawn 必须显式 wire:'native'|'jsonrpc'，message spawn 必须省略 wire；只有短形式补 native 默认。supervision.spec 包含 command/args/env/stdio/bootstrap/limits，bootstrap.stdin payload 与认证 token 一致。budget 限并存执行单元数量，不等于 OS 内存限制；isolation 可为 best-effort/required。spec.limits.callWallTimeMs 会压低每次调用可用截止。

rawChannel 必须返回本次真实 handle 的资源；establish 使用 prepared.offer/scheduler/signal/session/token/stderr 完成实际握手，不接收“已认证”声明替代操作。高级回调来源 async(context)=>sourceResult 不经过本包 supervision，不能据此获得 stop/restart/replace 权限。
TRemote 只提供业务方法类型；不传泛型时没有可调用方法，动态字符串调用用 IRuntimeDynamicSurface，运行时仍按已接纳目录拒绝未知方法。

blocks.text: 工厂 defaultTimeoutMs 默认 30000 ms，正有限 number；只有 request/stream 继承该默认。单次 timeoutMs 可为非负 number 或 false，0 立即到期，false 关闭默认超时；进程预算的 callWallTimeMs 仍可进一步限制。signal 是协作取消，本地结束等待不证明业务没执行。idempotencyKey 只有对端声明并保留对应结果时才复用；orderKey 对同键安排对端串行；cancel:'before-start' 在未开始时撤销，已开始则等待真实结果。

进程路径拒绝 transfer 属性，即使 []，ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array 普通传输会复制。超时、取消、断线和 outcome unknown 都不证明“对端没有执行”；非幂等写入先 outcome 或业务对账再决定重试。明确在 provider 前拒绝的 OVERLOADED/PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT 与成功 before-start 撤销应和已发出但结果未知的调用区分。

sections.heading: 名称、本机 socket 与认证

blocks.text: 短 connect/listen 字符串可为普通服务名或明确地址。普通名不带斜线/协议，由 OS 用户与名称派生相同端点；POSIX 使用 0700 私有用户目录与 0600 socket，拒绝不合所有者/权限的目录、符号链接及其它服务路径。Node-compatible API 不提供 peer credentials，权限只限制 OS 用户，同用户任意进程仍可接入；要区分应用，双方显式 token。

TCP 回环、显式 Unix 路径和未提供 ACL 保证的 Windows named pipe 必须 token；同用户公开 hello 标记不是 secret。只接受 tcp://127.0.0.1:port、tcp://[::1]:port、Unix 绝对路径或 Windows 命名管道，不接受跨机器地址。listen port=0 由 OS 分配，实际地址从 listener.address 读取。

connectTimeoutMs 默认 5000 ms，有限非负 number；只有普通 named local 来源才以最多 25 ms 间隔重试 ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED，显式地址拨号失败不走该重试。signal 取消待重试，保留原取消原因。第二个同名 listener 仍 PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED；只有既有 owner record 证明属于同服务的崩溃遗留路径才回收。

完整 connect 为 kind:'connect'、address/token、dial(address,signal)、establish，wire 默认 native，可配本地会话 supervision 的 restart/startupTimeoutMs/health/stop/terminalPolicy/scheduler；它只重建本端连接，不取得对端进程所有权。完整 listen 为 kind:'listener'、listen/address/offer/verify/createConnectionContext，可选 scheduler；verify 返回 principal，不能信客户端自报身份。每次接入有独立 peerId、session 和通道。凭据错误时 client 可外层 REMOTE_START_FAILED，server report 原 PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED，不用同凭据盲重试。

Socket listener 拥有监听与未交接资源，不自动拥有已经交出的会话。其 close 复用同一 Promise。Unix owner record 不等于原生路径删除的绝对保证：Node/libuv 在地址被外部 rename/替换后仍可能在原 listener.close 删除同址后继 inode，当前路径会报告一次 PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED/cause；重复关闭不重复报告。不要在活动 listener 的路径上另建 owner。现有 Darwin 路径预算为 104 字节，不额外缩短为隐藏 staging 地址。

sections.heading: PluginHost 出口、替换与描述符

blocks.text: createProcessPlugin 的运行时形式使用 Peer 相同来源/provide，增加 name 与 expose，返回待 Host.use 安装的插件。Host 持有连接，调用方不应再用另一套 owner 终止同一子进程。expose 默认空，只有明确的 Feature 方法路径可反向调用，列出 math.add 不会公开同级 math.sub。

host.process 的 request/notify/stream/group/outcome 第一个参数为连接名，或同名多实例时的 {name,instanceId}。list/get 查询连接、身份、代次、健康与退出，缺事实用 unavailable，不伪造 0；on 返回幂等解除函数，watch 是有界异步迭代；broadcast 分别汇总结果，不保证全部成功。stop/kill/restart/replace 仅 spawn-owned，借用 connect/listen 以 CAPABILITY_CONFLICT 拒绝。

replace 使用既有 supervision/Host 策略，不搬迁已经执行的调用。IProcessPlugin.replace 的 options 默认 {}，strategy 默认 stop-then-start；支持 spec 与 stop-then-start/start-then-switch 策略，结果分别含 supervisor outcome 或后继 plugin；不同策略的准备、切换和回收仍由原 owner 管理。Host execution 两个预算须按 PluginHost 契约显式给出，不能把无限 false 当成默认值。

根入口还提供 parseProcessPluginDescriptor 与 ProcessPluginWire。描述符是持久化配置数据，不含运行时通道、bootstrap 凭据或已认证状态；执行性端口必须由真实工厂提供。低层 IProcessPluginOptions 的 deployment/host/endpointFactory/registrationOwner 与便捷运行时来源形式应分别按其类型使用。

createProcessResilience 必填 scheduler/report，不创建第二个进程监督器。默认 idempotencyStore 使用该 owner 的独立命名空间，同 principal 的不同 connection/session 共享去重 scope，不同 owner 隔离。identity 必须给非空 principalId，connectionId/sessionId 用于各连接标签，processId 可选。
容量、超时与 drain 选项是正安全整数，不用 0 表示关闭；reportAtMs 从 terminal 进入时计时，首个 0 分钟报告由原 supervision 保留。超过默认未处理次数才启动清算，不把第一条诊断等同终态移除。

sessionOptions(identity) 返回接入 Endpoint 所需 idempotency 与 limits；listenRegistrations 接收 wire:'native'、真实 listen/address/offer、verifyToken、createConnectionContext、onCandidate 及可选 serviceId/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs/signal。onCandidate 只能 adopt/reject；listener 拥有未接纳候选，已经 adopt 的 lease 交给接纳者关闭，lease.channel/identity 与其 close 属于同一会话。认证后 principal 来自 verifier，不能跳过握手自行声明。

attachRegistration(name,binding,owner) 绑定真实 supervisor；binding.ownership 是 spawn-owned/connection-borrowed，health 是 ping/custom/none。owner 是 proxy-plugin 的 name/Host.unUse，或 standalone-host 的 release。callGuard 在 provider 前拒绝 terminal/liquidated，不需要另写调用旁路；inspect 返回状态、health、unhandled、liquidated 和原 reason，未知为 undefined。onTerminal 任一 handler fulfilled 即视为 handled、重置未处理计数并停止后续诊断；全部 rejected 才保持未处理，拒绝原因仍报告。
共享目标的显式实例健康失败会先关闭所有共享 sessions，再创建/替换后继；失败仍保持隔离并报告原错误。per-connection 只关受影响 session，不替换共享进程。连接速率/payload 超限在 provider 前 PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT；连续超时与空闲只关闭该连接，不证明整个共享实例坏了。

清算只使用 Host 已提交 affected plan，不拿 dry-run 当提交。post-removal cleanup 失败仍视为已提交，reason 保留 terminal 与 cleanup；pre-commit reject 或 standalone release 失败不记 liquidated tombstone、不自动重试该 Host mutation。默认 suspend 为实际受影响依赖启动诊断，cascade 清实际依赖且不再为已释放依赖启动诊断。仅保留最新 100 个已提交 tombstone，旧 registration.close 不能移除同名新代。

registration.close 只停该诊断/退订，不 dispose 外部 supervisor；resilience.close 释放自己开的 listener 与登记，稳定 Promise/allSettled，清理失败 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError。不要泛称关闭后所有只读方法都抛错；sessionOptions/inspect 等按其原接口保留行为。显式关闭实际 supervisor/Host 仍是其原 owner 的责任。

sections.id: 通道-握手-诊断与平台能力
sections.heading: 通道、握手、诊断与平台能力

blocks.text: IProcessByteChannel 是 kind:'byte' 的有序 write/onData/onClose/close，write 返回真实背压 Promise；IProcessMessageChannel 是 kind:'message' 的 send/onMessage/onClose/close。createProcessTransport 的 byte 参数必须选 initiator+offer 或 responder+offer+auth；responder auth 为 required/verify 或明确 none。common 参数包含 peerId/report/ipc、可选 signal/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs；ipc 至少 connectionId/sessionId/log，可选 processId、stderr、maxPendingData/maxPendingControl。

createNativeProcessOffer 必填 peer，可选 auth/stream/capabilities；直接基底为 ping/close/batch，stream:true 才直接加入 stream。capabilities 省略时，Runtime 绑定按 Core 已安装能力完成默认提议；显式列表（包括 []）不被自动拓宽，stream:false 仍禁止自动补 stream。offer 与版本/codec/peer 数据冻结，json codec 和当前 RpcProtocol 版本由 Contract 常量拥有。

消息通道 staticAgreement.local/peer 都必须 codec:'identity' 且 capabilities 相同、有序一致；这是输入声明检查，不授予已协商信任。既有基础能力 abort/ping/close/deadline/idempotency/trace/stream/batch 可直接使用，Runtime/二进制等扩展仍需 Core ACK，缺 ACK 或超时只保留实际基础能力，agreement.capabilities 反映接纳结果。

默认入站调用限额 maxPerPeer=64/maxGlobal=256，可用 providerLimits 覆盖并从 onRejected 读取原因；超过为 Core OVERLOADED，provider 未执行。不要与 resilience 每连接 32 并发默认混为一处限额。首帧握手受 PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_MAX_FRAME_BYTES=65536 字节限制，native 业务帧上限 16 MiB，握手与 message 扩展 ACK 默认 10000 ms。Core 待发送 data/control 默认 256/8。手动 receiveAdapterBootstrap/openProcessStdioChannel 未给 bootstrapTimeout 时不设 timer；automatic child 会显式给 10000 ms。大数据用 stream 或业务分片。

stderr 从启动就持续读取，1000 ms 内每 session 最多 32 条 ipc.stderr；额外片段合并 droppedChunks 摘要，文本脱敏，不把日志写 stdout。Native 默认 ping 每 5000 ms、单次 2000 ms、连续 3 次失败升级不健康，显式 custom health 优先；JSON-RPC 缺省不开 native ping。健康失败 PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED 交原监督策略，而非文档另起重启器。

Node/Bun/Deno stdio/socket 复用 Core 字节 framing。当前 transport.observe 已提供，旧“尚未实现”描述不再适用。字节观察同步 emit 一次，size 为完整 frame.byteLength，借用 detail 含 frameBytes/drainMs；inbound drainMs=0，outbound 初值 -1，物理 onWrite 完成后只更新同一 detail，不另发第二条异步 carrier event。capture 开启才给原 frame 引用，保留 metadata 应复制数值。Whole-message 内容是原 value 引用、detail=undefined，已知原生字节可给 size，opaque 未知为 -1，不为测大小序列化对象；observer 失败经 Core TRANSPORT 报告。逻辑 send 耗时不等于 drainMs，不把 Node 结果外推成 Electron 验证或速度结论。

Web Streams byte close 在回调前发布同一 Promise，失败仍尝试其余观察者、reader.cancel、writer.abort 与物理关闭；失败为 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError，首错在 cause、全体在 errors。writer 获取失败释放已获 reader 锁，原 TypeError 附 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED。自己取得的 Node/Deno/Web 字节构造仍需真实资源，不能用“已认证”对象替代。

适配器扩展可用 createAdapterSocketByteIO、createAdapterChildStdio、createAdapterProcessStdio、createAdapterWebByteIO，以及 createAdapterProcessLaunch/Peer/Plugin。新适配器优先复用 Core defineByteAdapter/defineMessageAdapter；复杂会话组合用原 advanced SDK，不复制 framing、握手、correlation 或生命周期。

普通外部子进程用 spawn:{command,args,wire:'jsonrpc',contract}，仍由原 spawn supervision 拥有；自有有序字节连接用 createProcessJsonRpcChannel。旧桥接工厂名统一为此入口，选项类型 IProcessJsonRpcChannelOptions，桥接错误常量从 rpc-contract/framing/jsonrpc 导入。Process 仅保留原 byte 的关闭/stderr/诊断，协议协商、correlation 与 cleanup 由 Core 拥有。

高级参数 byte/peerId/target/offer/token/scheduler/wallClock/ipc/report 明确提供，signal/handshakeTimeoutMs 可选，JSON-RPC 握手默认 10000 ms，不使用 native 长度前缀或默认 ping。target 为 {kind:'plugin',contract} 或 {kind:'host',catalog}；本地 contract 只预检不支持 stream，真正可调用目录来自对端 migaia.describe，不是调用方授予的目录。offer 中 codecs/auth 由桥接填写；可选能力仅 deadline@1、trace@1、idempotency@1，加自动必需的 jsonrpc-bridge@1/runtime-api@1/batch@1/abort@1/wire-error@1，不能随意扩 profile。

业务 error 使用 JSON-RPC error.code/message/data.migaiaWireError，wire 至少 source/code/name/message/stack，可选 cause/errors，不能在接收侧重造 stack。JSON-RPC 整数 code 可用 -32700 解析、-32600 请求、-32601 方法、-32602 参数、-32603 内部、-32000 业务；诊断语义仍用 wire source/code。Contract 的 toJsonRpcError/fromJsonRpcError 与 encodeJsonRpcFrame/createJsonRpcFrameDecoder 复用同一表示，不另建协议。
下表的 `source` 是保留的错误身份，由 `@migaia/rpc-contract` 定义，供 Process 的 JSON-RPC 字节连接报告失败；它不是包的导入路径。

sections.id: 在真实子进程中执行函数并关闭其所有者
sections.heading: 在真实子进程中执行函数并关闭其所有者

blocks.text: 主进程需要把计算移到另一个操作系统进程里，但只看到函数返回值，还无法判断代码究竟在哪里执行。
手写启动还要处理分帧、认证与清理；同一个入口重新执行时，若不先区分角色，子进程又会继续启动子进程。
先用 `isProcessChild()` 分支，子端提供方法，父端用 `spawn: true` 启动，并在 `finally` 中关闭返回的 Peer。
输出：

blocks.code:
42
true

blocks.text: 输出依次为 `42`、`true`：计算结果为 42，返回的原生进程 id 也确实不同于父进程。
父端拥有此子进程并显式关闭；Node 自派生入口必须是真实文件，不能是 eval 或测试运行器，也不保证终止所有后代进程。

spawn:true 重跑当前真实文件，isProcessChild 先分支，child 省略来源时只使用 launcher 已注入的 bootstrap。provide.double 接收 number 并返回两倍，pid 返回真实 process.pid；TRemote 只给静态业务类型。默认 defaultTimeoutMs=30000 ms，request 的 payload 是 21；finally 由拥有者 close。Node termination 仍是 best-effort，不以 PID 不同推导权限沙箱或整树终止。

sections.id: 在同一条子进程连接上使用反向调用与流
sections.heading: 在同一条子进程连接上使用反向调用与流

blocks.text: 子进程处理任务时，既要调用父端持有的服务，也要把一串结果逐项交回调用方。
分别搭建单向管道，就要重复处理路由和结果对应关系；把整串结果塞进一次响应，又迫使提供方先收集全部数据。
父端通过 `provide` 提供方法，子端拿自己的 Peer 反向请求；序列方法返回异步生成器，父端通过 `stream()` 消费。
输出：

blocks.code:
主端:任务
1,2,3

blocks.text: 输出为 `主端:任务`、`1,2,3`，证明子端等待了反向请求结果，父端也读取了流的三个值。
双向调用复用同一条已认证连接；流在开始迭代时才发送请求，`notify` 完成则只表示发送完成。
两边都 provide：父端 prefix 处理字符串，子端 label 等待父 Peer 再反向 request，count 返回 1..limit 的异步生成器。spawn:true 与默认期限同上一例；stream('count',3) 首次迭代才开始，values 数组只收业务结果。子端闭包保留真实工厂 Promise，不伪造已就绪 Peer；应用仍只由父端拥有所启动子进程。

sections.id: 关闭一个客户端后仍可连接本机命名服务
sections.heading: 关闭一个客户端后仍可连接本机命名服务

blocks.text: 一条 CLI 连接结束后，本机服务还需要继续接受后续调用方。
如果把持有连接误当成拥有服务进程或监听器，客户端清理时就可能释放其他调用方仍在使用的服务。
用唯一名称创建监听，再分别建立客户端；每个客户端先关闭自己的借用连接，最后才由服务端关闭监听。
输出：
输出为 `40`、`42`；第一个客户端关闭后，第二个客户端仍能连接并成功调用。
此例使用 Node/POSIX 的同用户端点权限，不能区分同一用户下的不同应用；Windows 以及显式地址需要提供 token。

name 用 randomUUID 避免与其它运行争用。同一普通名称由同 OS 用户派生端点，Node/POSIX 默认 0700 目录/0600 socket；这不鉴别同用户应用。listen.provide 暴露 double，两个 connect 先后各自关闭，server 最后关闭。connectTimeoutMs 默认 5000，仅 named local 对 ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED 重试；显式地址和 Windows 需 token。

sections.id: 把子进程服务及其释放交给-host
sections.heading: 把子进程服务及其释放交给 Host

blocks.text: 应用安装多个服务时，需要一个所有者在退出时统一关闭它们的进程连接。
把每个子进程分散保存在局部变量里，容易漏掉清理项，也容易把服务查找与原生进程所有权混在一起。
创建带名称的进程插件，用 `host.use()` 安装，经 `host.process` 调用，并在 `finally` 中释放 Host。
输出：

blocks.code:
42
spawn
true

blocks.text: 输出为 `42`、`spawn`、`true`：调用成功，出口识别出启动型连接，Host 清理也已完成。
Host 拥有已安装的子进程；两个执行预算都显式设为 `false`，表示不设上限，并非默认值，也不会回滚应用任意外部副作用。

service.name='service' 是 Host 内连接名，spawn:true 复用真实自派生，未给 expose 时默认无 Host 方法反向公开。defineHost 的 host.execution.mutationTimeoutMs 和 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 都显式 false（无上限），不是省略默认。host.use 安装，host.process.request 第一个参数选 service，list 的 kind=spawn，dispose 返回结构化 cleanupComplete；不宣称任意外部副作用回滚。

sections.id: 让重连复用同一去重范围并隔离不同身份
sections.heading: 让重连复用同一去重范围并隔离不同身份

blocks.text: 连接重建后，连接标签会变化，但同一个已认证身份的重试仍应指向同一份已保留结果范围。
只按连接划分会丢掉连续性；直接共用一个没有身份区分的范围，又可能把不同身份的结果混在一起。
用完整身份调用 `sessionOptions`，比较返回的存储与范围；这里仅演示配置派生，身份字段本身不构成认证。
输出：

blocks.code:
true
true
true
32 32

blocks.text: 输出为 `true`、`true`、`true`、`32 32`：同一治理对象共用存储，相同身份保持范围，不同身份使用不同范围。
此会话默认的全局和单对端并发上限都是 `32`；应用必须在认证成功后取得 `principalId`，再把这些配置用于实际连接。

createProcessResilience 必填 systemScheduler/report。三个 session identity 完整给 connectionId/sessionId/principalId；前两者只变标签，相同 account-A 仍同范围，account-B 分开。admission 的 token:'operation'/senderId:'caller' 仅是本例去重请求上下文，不是认证凭据。默认 maxConcurrentCallsPerConnection=32，所以返回 limits.maxGlobal/maxPerPeer 都是 32；必须在真实认证后使用 principalId。

sections.id: 真实子进程进入终态后拒绝新任务
sections.heading: 真实子进程进入终态后拒绝新任务

blocks.text: 受监督子进程退出，当前策略不会重启，但应用仍可能继续发送新任务。
缓存的就绪标记可能比真实进程活得更久；用诊断对象替代监督器，又会丢掉实际的生命周期边界。
把真实 Node 进程监督器登记到治理对象，等待它的终态通知，并在发送任务前执行返回的守卫。
输出：

blocks.code:
terminal none
PROCESS_TERMINAL_CALL
true
true
terminal

blocks.text: 输出依次为 `terminal none`、`PROCESS_TERMINAL_CALL`、`true`、`true`、`terminal`：守卫拒绝新任务，关闭复用同一 Promise，解除治理后监督器状态仍被保留。
子进程确实以退出码 `1` 结束，重启模式为 `never`；监听回调将该终态报告标记为已处理，调用方仍负责释放原始监督器。

真实 createProcessSupervisor 使用 Node launcher、maxUnits:1 budget、systemScheduler/report 和 best-effort；restart.mode='never'，spec.command 为当前 Node，args 的 -e 仅用于该直接 supervisor 的退出命令，不是 Peer 自派生入口。env 只继承 PATH，set={}，stdio 为 ignore/ignore/drain。binding 只转发真实 supervisor 方法，ownership='spawn-owned'、health='none'；standalone-host.release 指向实际 dispose。onTerminal 解除函数 off 可重复；回调正常完成表示 handled，guard.beforeDispatch 的 method/mode/generation 来自当前真实状态，治理 close 后原 supervisor 仍由 finally dispose。
本包拥有进程启动、stdio/socket 字节资源、bootstrap、来源认证和监督绑定；Core 拥有 Runtime Peer 调用、目录、超时、取消、幂等与错误还原。supervision 拥有执行单元、预算与重启，PluginHost 拥有插件安装、依赖与替换。Peer 与 Plugin 不应各建一套对同一子进程的关闭 owner。

直接安装 rpc-process、rpc-core、rpc-contract；后两者是 peer 依赖，不是“三者版本必须相等”的运行时检查。运行时依赖 plugin-host、supervision、utils。发布保留 dist/schema 和九个入口。包声明 Node>=18，本文实际执行的 TypeScript 示例使用 Node 24；没有把 Node 结果当作 Bun/Deno/Electron/Windows 验证。

Bun 启动、stdio 与本机 socket
Deno.Command、stdio 与本机 socket，需宿主权限
createElectronUtilityProcessLauncher，实际 whole-message 通道；可选 peer electron ^44.0.0
可选 peer koffi ^3.1.6；当前占位，全部能力 unsupported，launch 拒绝 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED

blocks.text: 只导入实际宿主入口；平台依赖在所选路径使用。进程间通信适合本机隔离任务和守护服务，不提供跨机器 socket。Worker 由 rpc-threads、浏览器窗口由 rpc-browser 负责。非 TypeScript 服务可使用 JSON-RPC 字节模式，不能把它当成原生 stream 或 transfer 支持。

sections.heading: Peer 来源、短启动与 bootstrap

blocks.text: createProcessPeer 的 spawn/connect/listen 必须恰选一种；由本包 launcher 启动的子进程才可省略来源，通过已有发现标记与 stdin bootstrap 连回父进程。直接 node service.js 不满足此前提，应显式 listen。provide 默认无业务方法，只接受自身可枚举数据属性与嵌套方法组；点分路径如 math.double，getter、循环、重复路径和非法名字在连接前拒绝。普通函数用于 request/notify，iterable/async iterable 用 stream；payload/结果仍受 Core 可移植值契约约束。

rows: 经 supervision 拥有子进程及连接
清连接并停止所拥有子进程
只拥有自己的本地连接，对端进程外借
清本端连接，不结束服务进程

停接纳并关闭会话，不拥有客户端进程

blocks.text: 双方可 provide 并反向调用。子进程 Peer 会保持事件循环直到父连接关闭；正常 parent-loss 路径处理子进程退出，但强杀父进程时无法承诺父端清理已执行，更不能保证孙进程都终止。
短 spawn 接受 true、入口字符串/URL 或普通对象。true 重跑当前主入口全部顶层代码，必须先 isProcessChild 分支，避免无限自派生；该函数只读既有 bootstrap 标记，发现阶段消费标记后仍为 true，不代替认证。REPL/eval/test runner、Electron 和无可用主入口的单文件程序不支持自派生，应给精确入口或显式 command/args。

command 省略用当前运行时；显式 command 的 args 默认 []；spawn:true 继承程序 argv.slice(2)，其它入口的应用参数默认 []

blocks.text: Node/Bun 保留 runtime flags 与 --import loader，移除 eval/print/test 控制参数。Node 原生类型剥离不把 .js import 改成 .ts；这类源码使用构建后的 JS 或实际 loader，Bun 可解析其支持的 TS 导入。Deno 默认 run 仅给 PATH 与 bootstrap 标记所需 env 权限，额外权限用显式 command/args。不要把自己测试运行器的主入口当作可派生业务入口。
PROCESS_RUNTIME_API_ENV 的公开值为 MIGAIA_RPC_RUNTIME_API_BOOTSTRAP，版本标记为 '1'；它是发现信息，不是 secret。实际 bootstrap 先读 4 字节大端长度和对应内容，独立元数据封套不改变 RPC 握手语法；运行时 bootstrap 等待默认 10000 ms，之后才进入原握手截止。

Node launcher 不开 shell，只传显式环境，先开始 stderr drain 再写 bootstrap，stdout channel 不再被普通输出消费者抢读。Node 声明 fault isolation 与 stdin bootstrap enforced，但 termination、内存/CPU/permissions/fd bootstrap 不作 enforced 保证；POSIX 可尝试进程组终止，Windows 尽力停止直接子进程，均不能承诺整树必定终止。required isolation 不能当作 Node best-effort 的别名。

短来源 spawn.supervision.startupTimeoutMs 默认 10000；restart 内平铺 mode:'on-failure'、maxRestarts:5、windowMs:60000、initialDelayMs:250、factor:2、maxDelayMs:30000；stop.drainTimeoutMs/stop.reapTimeoutMs 默认均 5000。restart.mode 仅 never/on-failure/always，分别不重启、失败重启、退出后始终重启。Process managed binding 另复用 Core 5000 ms 调用 drain，并受 stop 剩余预算收窄，不保证无限等待全部不合作调用。
短来源省略 report 时，同一原生进程最多合并报告一次预期 termination unsupported 提示；显式 report 每次启动都收到，直接传默认函数与包装它没有差异。onNotice 可替代该项 reporter 调用。其它错误照常报告，完整来源保持其显式 reporter 语义。
wrap(command) 每次首次启动、restart、replace 都执行，接收并仅能返回 command、args、cwd、env；自定义 launcher 同样经过它。macOS 可由应用选择 sandbox-exec/profile，Linux 可选择 bwrap/只读挂载与隔离网络；本包不安装工具、不维护沙箱策略，也不把这些平台示意当作已执行验证。

包装器必须透传 stdin/stdout：stdin 先承载 token/bootstrap，再承载 RPC，stdout 只能是协议帧，日志写 stderr。保留 env.inherit/env.set；launcher 在 wrap 后加入 MIGAIA_RPC_RUNTIME_API_BOOTSTRAP，容器包装还需转入此变量与原环境。原退出码必须保留，不能把非零改成成功。wrap 返回的 stdio/bootstrap/limits/permissions 额外字段不授予更改这些资源的权限。
非函数 wrap 在准备阶段拒绝；回调抛错或非法返回使启动失败，PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION TypeError 位于 supervision LAUNCH_FAILED 的 cause 链，回调原值保留 cause。Host 安装最外层仍可为 PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED，不按 message 判断。

完整 spawn 对象显式组合 kind:'spawn'、channelKind:'byte'|'message'、supervision、rawChannel(handle,signal)、establish(raw,prepared)、token 与可选 offer。完整 byte spawn 必须显式 wire:'native'|'jsonrpc'，message spawn 必须省略 wire；只有短形式补 native 默认。supervision.spec 包含 command/args/env/stdio/bootstrap/limits，bootstrap.stdin payload 与认证 token 一致。budget 限并存执行单元数量，不等于 OS 内存限制；isolation 可为 best-effort/required。spec.limits.callWallTimeMs 会压低每次调用可用截止。

rawChannel 必须返回本次真实 handle 的资源；establish 使用 prepared.offer/scheduler/signal/session/token/stderr 完成实际握手，不接收“已认证”声明替代操作。高级回调来源 async(context)=>sourceResult 不经过本包 supervision，不能据此获得 stop/restart/replace 权限。
TRemote 只提供业务方法类型；不传泛型时没有可调用方法，动态字符串调用用 IRuntimeDynamicSurface，运行时仍按已接纳目录拒绝未知方法。

rows: 等待标量结果，保留原操作错误

blocks.text: 工厂 defaultTimeoutMs 默认 30000 ms，正有限 number；只有 request/stream 继承该默认。单次 timeoutMs 可为非负 number 或 false，0 立即到期，false 关闭默认超时；进程预算的 callWallTimeMs 仍可进一步限制。signal 是协作取消，本地结束等待不证明业务没执行。idempotencyKey 只有对端声明并保留对应结果时才复用；orderKey 对同键安排对端串行；cancel:'before-start' 在未开始时撤销，已开始则等待真实结果。

进程路径拒绝 transfer 属性，即使 []，ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array 普通传输会复制。超时、取消、断线和 outcome unknown 都不证明“对端没有执行”；非幂等写入先 outcome 或业务对账再决定重试。明确在 provider 前拒绝的 OVERLOADED/PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT 与成功 before-start 撤销应和已发出但结果未知的调用区分。

sections.heading: 名称、本机 socket 与认证

blocks.text: 短 connect/listen 字符串可为普通服务名或明确地址。普通名不带斜线/协议，由 OS 用户与名称派生相同端点；POSIX 使用 0700 私有用户目录与 0600 socket，拒绝不合所有者/权限的目录、符号链接及其它服务路径。Node-compatible API 不提供 peer credentials，权限只限制 OS 用户，同用户任意进程仍可接入；要区分应用，双方显式 token。

TCP 回环、显式 Unix 路径和未提供 ACL 保证的 Windows named pipe 必须 token；同用户公开 hello 标记不是 secret。只接受 tcp://127.0.0.1:port、tcp://[::1]:port、Unix 绝对路径或 Windows 命名管道，不接受跨机器地址。listen port=0 由 OS 分配，实际地址从 listener.address 读取。

connectTimeoutMs 默认 5000 ms，有限非负 number；只有普通 named local 来源才以最多 25 ms 间隔重试 ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED，显式地址拨号失败不走该重试。signal 取消待重试，保留原取消原因。第二个同名 listener 仍 PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED；只有既有 owner record 证明属于同服务的崩溃遗留路径才回收。

完整 connect 为 kind:'connect'、address/token、dial(address,signal)、establish，wire 默认 native，可配本地会话 supervision 的 restart/startupTimeoutMs/health/stop/terminalPolicy/scheduler；它只重建本端连接，不取得对端进程所有权。完整 listen 为 kind:'listener'、listen/address/offer/verify/createConnectionContext，可选 scheduler；verify 返回 principal，不能信客户端自报身份。每次接入有独立 peerId、session 和通道。凭据错误时 client 可外层 REMOTE_START_FAILED，server report 原 PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED，不用同凭据盲重试。

Socket listener 拥有监听与未交接资源，不自动拥有已经交出的会话。其 close 复用同一 Promise。Unix owner record 不等于原生路径删除的绝对保证：Node/libuv 在地址被外部 rename/替换后仍可能在原 listener.close 删除同址后继 inode，当前路径会报告一次 PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED/cause；重复关闭不重复报告。不要在活动 listener 的路径上另建 owner。现有 Darwin 路径预算为 104 字节，不额外缩短为隐藏 staging 地址。

sections.heading: PluginHost 出口、替换与描述符

blocks.text: createProcessPlugin 的运行时形式使用 Peer 相同来源/provide，增加 name 与 expose，返回待 Host.use 安装的插件。Host 持有连接，调用方不应再用另一套 owner 终止同一子进程。expose 默认空，只有明确的 Feature 方法路径可反向调用，列出 math.add 不会公开同级 math.sub。

host.process 的 request/notify/stream/group/outcome 第一个参数为连接名，或同名多实例时的 {name,instanceId}。list/get 查询连接、身份、代次、健康与退出，缺事实用 unavailable，不伪造 0；on 返回幂等解除函数，watch 是有界异步迭代；broadcast 分别汇总结果，不保证全部成功。stop/kill/restart/replace 仅 spawn-owned，借用 connect/listen 以 CAPABILITY_CONFLICT 拒绝。

replace 使用既有 supervision/Host 策略，不搬迁已经执行的调用。IProcessPlugin.replace 的 options 默认 {}，strategy 默认 stop-then-start；支持 spec 与 stop-then-start/start-then-switch 策略，结果分别含 supervisor outcome 或后继 plugin；不同策略的准备、切换和回收仍由原 owner 管理。Host execution 两个预算须按 PluginHost 契约显式给出，不能把无限 false 当成默认值。

根入口还提供 parseProcessPluginDescriptor 与 ProcessPluginWire。描述符是持久化配置数据，不含运行时通道、bootstrap 凭据或已认证状态；执行性端口必须由真实工厂提供。低层 IProcessPluginOptions 的 deployment/host/endpointFactory/registrationOwner 与便捷运行时来源形式应分别按其类型使用。

createProcessResilience 必填 scheduler/report，不创建第二个进程监督器。默认 idempotencyStore 使用该 owner 的独立命名空间，同 principal 的不同 connection/session 共享去重 scope，不同 owner 隔离。identity 必须给非空 principalId，connectionId/sessionId 用于各连接标签，processId 可选。
容量、超时与 drain 选项是正安全整数，不用 0 表示关闭；reportAtMs 从 terminal 进入时计时，首个 0 分钟报告由原 supervision 保留。超过默认未处理次数才启动清算，不把第一条诊断等同终态移除。

sessionOptions(identity) 返回接入 Endpoint 所需 idempotency 与 limits；listenRegistrations 接收 wire:'native'、真实 listen/address/offer、verifyToken、createConnectionContext、onCandidate 及可选 serviceId/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs/signal。onCandidate 只能 adopt/reject；listener 拥有未接纳候选，已经 adopt 的 lease 交给接纳者关闭，lease.channel/identity 与其 close 属于同一会话。认证后 principal 来自 verifier，不能跳过握手自行声明。

attachRegistration(name,binding,owner) 绑定真实 supervisor；binding.ownership 是 spawn-owned/connection-borrowed，health 是 ping/custom/none。owner 是 proxy-plugin 的 name/Host.unUse，或 standalone-host 的 release。callGuard 在 provider 前拒绝 terminal/liquidated，不需要另写调用旁路；inspect 返回状态、health、unhandled、liquidated 和原 reason，未知为 undefined。onTerminal 任一 handler fulfilled 即视为 handled、重置未处理计数并停止后续诊断；全部 rejected 才保持未处理，拒绝原因仍报告。
共享目标的显式实例健康失败会先关闭所有共享 sessions，再创建/替换后继；失败仍保持隔离并报告原错误。per-connection 只关受影响 session，不替换共享进程。连接速率/payload 超限在 provider 前 PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT；连续超时与空闲只关闭该连接，不证明整个共享实例坏了。

清算只使用 Host 已提交 affected plan，不拿 dry-run 当提交。post-removal cleanup 失败仍视为已提交，reason 保留 terminal 与 cleanup；pre-commit reject 或 standalone release 失败不记 liquidated tombstone、不自动重试该 Host mutation。默认 suspend 为实际受影响依赖启动诊断，cascade 清实际依赖且不再为已释放依赖启动诊断。仅保留最新 100 个已提交 tombstone，旧 registration.close 不能移除同名新代。

registration.close 只停该诊断/退订，不 dispose 外部 supervisor；resilience.close 释放自己开的 listener 与登记，稳定 Promise/allSettled，清理失败 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError。不要泛称关闭后所有只读方法都抛错；sessionOptions/inspect 等按其原接口保留行为。显式关闭实际 supervisor/Host 仍是其原 owner 的责任。

sections.id: 通道-握手-诊断与平台能力
sections.heading: 通道、握手、诊断与平台能力

blocks.text: IProcessByteChannel 是 kind:'byte' 的有序 write/onData/onClose/close，write 返回真实背压 Promise；IProcessMessageChannel 是 kind:'message' 的 send/onMessage/onClose/close。createProcessTransport 的 byte 参数必须选 initiator+offer 或 responder+offer+auth；responder auth 为 required/verify 或明确 none。common 参数包含 peerId/report/ipc、可选 signal/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs；ipc 至少 connectionId/sessionId/log，可选 processId、stderr、maxPendingData/maxPendingControl。

createNativeProcessOffer 必填 peer，可选 auth/stream/capabilities；直接基底为 ping/close/batch，stream:true 才直接加入 stream。capabilities 省略时，Runtime 绑定按 Core 已安装能力完成默认提议；显式列表（包括 []）不被自动拓宽，stream:false 仍禁止自动补 stream。offer 与版本/codec/peer 数据冻结，json codec 和当前 RpcProtocol 版本由 Contract 常量拥有。

消息通道 staticAgreement.local/peer 都必须 codec:'identity' 且 capabilities 相同、有序一致；这是输入声明检查，不授予已协商信任。既有基础能力 abort/ping/close/deadline/idempotency/trace/stream/batch 可直接使用，Runtime/二进制等扩展仍需 Core ACK，缺 ACK 或超时只保留实际基础能力，agreement.capabilities 反映接纳结果。

默认入站调用限额 maxPerPeer=64/maxGlobal=256，可用 providerLimits 覆盖并从 onRejected 读取原因；超过为 Core OVERLOADED，provider 未执行。不要与 resilience 每连接 32 并发默认混为一处限额。首帧握手受 PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_MAX_FRAME_BYTES=65536 字节限制，native 业务帧上限 16 MiB，握手与 message 扩展 ACK 默认 10000 ms。Core 待发送 data/control 默认 256/8。手动 receiveAdapterBootstrap/openProcessStdioChannel 未给 bootstrapTimeout 时不设 timer；automatic child 会显式给 10000 ms。大数据用 stream 或业务分片。

stderr 从启动就持续读取，1000 ms 内每 session 最多 32 条 ipc.stderr；额外片段合并 droppedChunks 摘要，文本脱敏，不把日志写 stdout。Native 默认 ping 每 5000 ms、单次 2000 ms、连续 3 次失败升级不健康，显式 custom health 优先；JSON-RPC 缺省不开 native ping。健康失败 PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED 交原监督策略，而非文档另起重启器。

Node/Bun/Deno stdio/socket 复用 Core 字节 framing。当前 transport.observe 已提供，旧“尚未实现”描述不再适用。字节观察同步 emit 一次，size 为完整 frame.byteLength，借用 detail 含 frameBytes/drainMs；inbound drainMs=0，outbound 初值 -1，物理 onWrite 完成后只更新同一 detail，不另发第二条异步 carrier event。capture 开启才给原 frame 引用，保留 metadata 应复制数值。Whole-message 内容是原 value 引用、detail=undefined，已知原生字节可给 size，opaque 未知为 -1，不为测大小序列化对象；observer 失败经 Core TRANSPORT 报告。逻辑 send 耗时不等于 drainMs，不把 Node 结果外推成 Electron 验证或速度结论。

Web Streams byte close 在回调前发布同一 Promise，失败仍尝试其余观察者、reader.cancel、writer.abort 与物理关闭；失败为 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError，首错在 cause、全体在 errors。writer 获取失败释放已获 reader 锁，原 TypeError 附 PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED。自己取得的 Node/Deno/Web 字节构造仍需真实资源，不能用“已认证”对象替代。

适配器扩展可用 createAdapterSocketByteIO、createAdapterChildStdio、createAdapterProcessStdio、createAdapterWebByteIO，以及 createAdapterProcessLaunch/Peer/Plugin。新适配器优先复用 Core defineByteAdapter/defineMessageAdapter；复杂会话组合用原 advanced SDK，不复制 framing、握手、correlation 或生命周期。

普通外部子进程用 spawn:{command,args,wire:'jsonrpc',contract}，仍由原 spawn supervision 拥有；自有有序字节连接用 createProcessJsonRpcChannel。旧桥接工厂名统一为此入口，选项类型 IProcessJsonRpcChannelOptions，桥接错误常量从 rpc-contract/framing/jsonrpc 导入。Process 仅保留原 byte 的关闭/stderr/诊断，协议协商、correlation 与 cleanup 由 Core 拥有。

高级参数 byte/peerId/target/offer/token/scheduler/wallClock/ipc/report 明确提供，signal/handshakeTimeoutMs 可选，JSON-RPC 握手默认 10000 ms，不使用 native 长度前缀或默认 ping。target 为 {kind:'plugin',contract} 或 {kind:'host',catalog}；本地 contract 只预检不支持 stream，真正可调用目录来自对端 migaia.describe，不是调用方授予的目录。offer 中 codecs/auth 由桥接填写；可选能力仅 deadline@1、trace@1、idempotency@1，加自动必需的 jsonrpc-bridge@1/runtime-api@1/batch@1/abort@1/wire-error@1，不能随意扩 profile。

rows: 子进程先读取 4 字节大端长度与 UTF-8 token，再读消息；socket token 由应用事先共享
Content-Length 按 UTF-8 字节数，CRLF CRLF 后为 JSON；header≤1024 bytes，单帧≤16 MiB

blocks.text: Call functions in a child process or local service with typed requests and streams, while an explicit owner manages connections, supervision, and cleanup.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A result returns without proving computation left the main process because launch and call ownership are unclear.
Reverse calls use another pipe because bidirectional routing and response correlation are rebuilt separately.
One CLI client shuts down a shared service because borrowing a connection is confused with process ownership.
Reconnects lose retained outcomes or mix principals because deduplication scopes follow temporary connection labels.
A stale ready flag still dispatches work after the actual supervisor enters terminal state.

Execute a business function in a real operating-system child. Spawn and Core calls share the supervised connection, while the returned PID demonstrates the process boundary, demonstrated in Run a function in a real child and close its owner.

Use reverse requests and iterative results over one connection. Both parties provide methods through the same authentication and catalog, enabling parent-service calls and child generators, demonstrated in Use reverse calls and streaming on the same child connection.

Keep connection cleanup separate from service ownership. connect releases only its local connection while the named listener remains available to another caller, demonstrated in Close one client while leaving a named local service available.

Keep principal-label scopes stable across reconnections. sessionOptions derives owner-local scopes from application-supplied principalId, sharing store/scope for one principal while separating another, demonstrated in Keep retry scopes stable across reconnections and separate principals.

Reject new work before dispatch after real terminal state. callGuard uses the registered supervisor's terminal state, and removing governance does not dispose an externally owned supervisor, demonstrated in Reject new work after a real child reaches terminal state.

blocks.text: This module owns process launch, stdio/socket resources, bootstrap discovery, authentication, and supervisor bindings. Core owns Runtime Peer calls, catalogs, deadlines, cancellation, idempotency, and error reconstruction. supervision owns execution units, budgets, and restarting; PluginHost owns installation, dependencies, and replacement. Do not create competing shutdown owners for one child.

Install rpc-process, rpc-core, and rpc-contract directly. The latter two are peer dependencies, without a runtime requirement that all versions be numerically equal. Runtime dependencies are plugin-host, supervision, and utils. Publishing retains dist/schema and nine entries. The manifest supports Node>=18; these TypeScript examples were executed with Node 24, not as evidence for Bun, Deno, Electron, or Windows.

sections.heading: Peer sources, short launch, and bootstrap

blocks.text: Choose exactly one spawn/connect/listen source. Only a child launched by this library may omit all three and discover its parent through the existing marker and stdin bootstrap. Direct node service.js does not satisfy that condition; independently started services should listen explicitly. provide defaults to no application methods and accepts own enumerable data properties and nested method groups. Names become dotted paths such as math.double. Accessors, cycles, duplicates, and invalid names fail before connection. Scalar functions use request/notify; iterable/async-iterable methods use stream. Core's portable-value domain still applies.

blocks.text: Both parties may provide methods and make reverse calls. A child Peer keeps its event loop alive until parent connection closure. The ordinary parent-loss path handles child exit, but forcibly killing the parent cannot guarantee that parent cleanup ran or that every descendant terminates.

Short spawn accepts true, an entry string/URL, or a configuration object. true reruns the entire main module; branch on isProcessChild first to avoid recursive spawning. That function reads existing discovery state, remains true after discovery consumes the marker, and grants no authentication. Self-spawn excludes REPL/eval/test runners, Electron, and single executables lacking a usable main entry; use an exact entry or command/args instead.

blocks.text: Node/Bun retain runtime flags and --import loaders while removing eval/print/test control arguments. Node type stripping does not rewrite .js imports to .ts; use built JavaScript or a real loader for that source layout. Bun resolves supported TypeScript imports. Deno's default run grants only PATH/bootstrap environment access; extra permissions require explicit command/args. A test runner's entry is not a self-spawnable business module.

PROCESS_RUNTIME_API_ENV is MIGAIA_RPC_RUNTIME_API_BOOTSTRAP with discovery version '1'; it is nonsecret discovery data. Actual bootstrap starts with a four-byte big-endian length and content. Its separate metadata envelope does not change the RPC handshake grammar. Runtime bootstrap defaults to 10000 ms, followed by the ordinary handshake deadline.

Node launches without a shell or implicit environment inheritance, drains stderr before writing bootstrap, and never also consumes channel stdout as ordinary output. It advertises enforced fault isolation/stdin bootstrap but not enforced termination, memory, CPU, permission, or fd-bootstrap capability. POSIX can attempt process-group termination and Windows can attempt direct-child termination; neither is a promise that every descendant ends. Required isolation cannot be substituted for Node best-effort behavior.

Short-source spawn.supervision.startupTimeoutMs defaults to 10000. Its restart object has flat fields mode:'on-failure', maxRestarts:5, windowMs:60000, initialDelayMs:250, factor:2, maxDelayMs:30000. stop.drainTimeoutMs/stop.reapTimeoutMs both default to 5000. restart.mode is never/on-failure/always: no restart, restart on failure, or restart after every exit. Process managed bindings also reuse Core's 5000-ms call drain, narrowed by remaining stop budget rather than waiting indefinitely for uncooperative calls.

With report omitted, short sources coalesce the expected unsupported-termination notice once per native process. Explicit report receives it per launch, whether the default function is supplied directly or wrapped. onNotice replaces that particular reporter delivery. Other errors remain reported, and full sources retain explicit reporting policy.

sections.heading: External sandbox wrappers and full sources

blocks.text: wrap(command) runs on initial launch, restart, and replacement, including a custom launcher. It receives and may return only command, args, cwd, and env. Applications may choose sandbox-exec/profiles on macOS or bwrap/read-only mounts/network isolation on Linux. This module installs no sandbox tools or policies, and those platform descriptions are not execution evidence.

A wrapper must preserve stdin/stdout: stdin first carries bootstrap and then RPC, stdout contains only protocol frames, and logs use stderr. Preserve env.inherit/env.set. The launcher adds MIGAIA_RPC_RUNTIME_API_BOOTSTRAP after wrapping; container wrappers must forward it and the original environment. Preserve the real exit code rather than converting failure into success. Returned stdio/bootstrap/limits/permissions fields do not acquire authority over those resources.

A nonfunction wrap fails during source preparation. A throw or invalid return fails launch with PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION TypeError reachable through supervision LAUNCH_FAILED, retaining a thrown callback value on cause. Host installation can add outer PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED; classify identities rather than message text.

A full spawn combines kind:'spawn', channelKind:'byte'|'message', supervision, rawChannel(handle,signal), establish(raw,prepared), token, and optional offer. Full byte spawn must explicitly select wire:'native'|'jsonrpc'; message spawn must omit wire. Only short forms add the native default. supervision.spec owns command/args/env/stdio/bootstrap/limits, and stdin bootstrap bytes must match authentication token. A budget bounds simultaneous units, not OS memory. isolation is best-effort/required, and spec.limits.callWallTimeMs caps individual call deadlines.

rawChannel returns this launch's real handle resources. establish uses prepared offer/scheduler/signal/session/token/stderr to authenticate the real channel, not a claimed authenticated DTO. Advanced callback sources async(context)=>sourceResult bypass this module's supervision and do not grant stop/restart/replace capability.

TRemote supplies business typing only. With no generic surface there are no callable method types; IRuntimeDynamicSurface permits dynamic strings at compile time while the accepted remote catalog still rejects unknown methods.

blocks.text: defaultTimeoutMs is 30000 ms and must be a positive finite number; only request/stream inherit it. A call's timeoutMs may be a nonnegative number or false: 0 expires immediately and false disables the default deadline, while a process callWallTimeMs cap may still apply. signal cancellation is cooperative and does not prove business nonexecution. idempotencyKey reuses outcomes only when the provider declared and retained them. orderKey serializes a key at the provider. cancel:'before-start' cancels unstarted work but waits for the real outcome once it has started.

Process calls reject the transfer property even when []. Ordinary ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array payloads are copied. Timeout, cancellation, disconnection, and unknown outcome do not prove that execution never happened. Reconcile non-idempotent writes through outcome or business state before retrying. Distinguish admission failures such as OVERLOADED/PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT and successful before-start cancellation from sent calls whose outcome is unknown.

Short connect/listen strings may be plain service names or explicit addresses. Names contain no slash/protocol and derive one endpoint from OS user and name. POSIX uses a private 0700 user directory and 0600 socket, rejecting wrong owners/permissions, symlinks, and other services' paths. Node-compatible APIs expose no peer-credential reader here; OS permissions isolate users, not applications within one user. Supply a token to distinguish those applications.

Loopback TCP, explicit Unix paths, and Windows named pipes without an adapter ACL require tokens. The same-user hello marker is public protocol data, not a secret. Supported addresses are tcp://127.0.0.1:port, tcp://[::1]:port, absolute Unix paths, and Windows named pipes, never remote-machine addresses. Port 0 lets the OS choose a port returned through listener.address.

connectTimeoutMs defaults to 5000 ms and accepts a finite nonnegative number. Only named-local rendezvous retries ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED at up-to-25-ms intervals; explicit-address dialing does not. signal cancels a pending retry with its original reason. A second same-name listener still fails PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED. Existing owner records reclaim only abandoned same-service paths.

Full connect contains kind:'connect', address/token, dial(address,signal), establish, optional offer, and native wire by default. Optional local-session supervision can set restart/startupTimeoutMs/health/stop/terminalPolicy/scheduler; it rebuilds the connection without owning or restarting the external process. Full listen contains kind:'listener', listen/address/offer/verify/createConnectionContext and optional scheduler. Each accepted session has its own labels and channel. verify returns the principal rather than trusting self-reported client identity. Invalid credentials can produce outer REMOTE_START_FAILED on the client and original PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED in the server reporter; do not blindly repeat them.

A socket listener owns listening and unhanded candidates, not sessions already transferred. close shares one Promise. Unix owner records do not guarantee native path deletion safety after external replacement: Node/libuv may unlink a successor inode installed at the old path when the original listener closes. The current path reports PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED/cause once, without repeating on later closes. Do not replace an active listener's path with another owner. The existing Darwin path budget is 104 bytes without a shorter hidden staging address.

The runtime createProcessPlugin form adds name/expose to Peer sources/provide, producing a plugin for Host.use. Host owns that installed process connection; another owner should not independently terminate it. expose defaults to no Host methods. Explicit Feature method paths are whitelisted individually: exposing math.add does not expose math.sub.

host.process request/notify/stream/group/outcome take a connection name or {name,instanceId} when exact instance selection is required. list/get expose identity, generation, health, and exit information, returning unavailable rather than invented zeros. on returns an idempotent disposer; watch is bounded async iteration. broadcast aggregates individual results without all-success guarantees. stop/kill/restart/replace require spawn ownership; connect/listen reject with CAPABILITY_CONFLICT.

Replacement uses existing supervision/Host strategies without moving calls already executing. IProcessPlugin.replace defaults options to {} and strategy to stop-then-start, accepting optional spec and stop-then-start/start-then-switch strategies; results carry the underlying supervisor outcome or successor plugin. Original owners retain preparation, switching, and retirement. Both Host execution budgets must be explicit under PluginHost's contract; false means unlimited rather than a default.

Root also exports parseProcessPluginDescriptor and ProcessPluginWire. A descriptor is persistent configuration data without live channels, bootstrap credentials, or authenticated state. Executable ports come from actual factories. Low-level IProcessPluginOptions deployment/host/endpointFactory/registrationOwner and convenient runtime-source options are distinct public shapes.

createProcessResilience requires scheduler/report and does not create another process supervisor. Its default idempotency store uses an owner-specific namespace. Different connections/sessions of one principal share a deduplication scope; separate owners remain isolated. identity requires a nonempty principalId, with connectionId/sessionId labels and optional processId.

Capacity, timeout, and drain options are positive safe integers; 0 does not disable them. Report times are relative to terminal entry, with the original supervisor retaining its zero-minute report. Liquidation follows the unhandled threshold rather than treating the first diagnostic as removal.

sessionOptions(identity) supplies Endpoint idempotency/limits. listenRegistrations accepts wire:'native', a real listen/address/offer, verifyToken, createConnectionContext, onCandidate, and optional serviceId/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs/signal. onCandidate returns adopt/reject. The listener owns pending candidates, while an adopted lease passes to its adopter. lease.channel/identity/close form one session. Principals come from authentication; declaring fields cannot skip a handshake.

attachRegistration(name,binding,owner) connects a real supervisor. binding.ownership is spawn-owned/connection-borrowed and health is ping/custom/none. The owner is either proxy-plugin name/Host.unUse or standalone-host release. callGuard rejects terminal/liquidated work before provider execution. inspect returns state/health/unhandled/liquidated/reason or undefined for unknown names. Any fulfilled onTerminal handler counts as handled, resets unhandled accounting, and stops later diagnostics; only all-rejected outcomes remain unhandled, with rejection causes reported.

Explicit shared-instance health failure closes shared sessions before creating/replacing the target; failure keeps it fenced and reports the original reason. Per-connection mode closes only the affected session rather than replacing the shared process. Connection/rate/payload admission fails PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT before business execution. Consecutive timeouts and idle expiry close that connection without proving whole-instance failure.

Liquidation uses only the Host's committed affected plan, never a dry run as proof of mutation. Post-removal cleanup errors still count as committed and retain terminal/cleanup causes. Precommit rejection or standalone release failure creates no liquidated tombstone and does not retry the Host mutation automatically. Default suspend starts diagnostics for actually affected dependants; cascade releases actual dependants without starting diagnostics for already-released ones. Only the newest 100 committed tombstones remain. An old registration.close cannot remove a replacement generation.

registration.close stops its diagnostics/subscription without disposing an external supervisor. resilience.close releases listeners/registrations it owns, shares one allSettled cleanup Promise, and rejects cleanup failure as PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError. Not every read method becomes a closed-state exception; sessionOptions/inspect retain their original behavior. The actual supervisor/Host owner still disposes those resources.

sections.heading: Channels, negotiation, diagnostics, and platform capability

blocks.text: IProcessByteChannel is an ordered kind:'byte' write/onData/onClose/close port whose write Promise retains backpressure. IProcessMessageChannel supplies kind:'message' send/onMessage/onClose/close. Byte createProcessTransport requires initiator+offer or responder+offer+auth; responder auth is required/verify or explicit none. Common options include peerId/report/ipc and optional signal/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs. ipc requires connectionId/sessionId/log and optionally processId, stderr, maxPendingData/maxPendingControl.

createNativeProcessOffer requires peer and optionally auth/stream/capabilities. Its direct baseline is ping/close/batch, adding stream only for stream:true. Omitted capabilities lets Runtime complete defaults from actually installed Core capabilities. Explicit lists, including [], are not widened automatically; stream:false prevents automatic stream expansion. Offer/version/codec/peer data is frozen, and Contract owns the json codec and current RpcProtocol version.

Message staticAgreement.local/peer must both use codec:'identity' with identical ordered capability lists. This validates input declarations rather than minting negotiated trust. Existing base abort/ping/close/deadline/idempotency/trace/stream/batch capabilities are directly usable; Runtime/binary extensions still require Core ACK. Missing ACK or timeout leaves actual base capabilities, visible through agreement.capabilities.

Default inbound providerLimits are maxPerPeer=64/maxGlobal=256, with rejection reasons available through onRejected. Exceeding limits produces Core OVERLOADED before execution. These differ from resilience's 32-per-session concurrency defaults. PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_MAX_FRAME_BYTES=65536 bounds the initial handshake frame; native business frames are limited to 16 MiB. Handshake and message-extension ACK deadlines default to 10000 ms. Core pending-send data/control limits default to 256/8. Manual receiveAdapterBootstrap/openProcessStdioChannel has no timer when bootstrapTimeout is omitted; automatic child discovery explicitly supplies 10000 ms. Use stream or application chunking for large values.

stderr drains from launch. Each session produces at most 32 ipc.stderr records per 1000 ms, merging excess chunks into a redacted droppedChunks summary. stdout is never a log channel. Native ping defaults to 5000-ms intervals, 2000-ms checks, and three failures before unhealthy; explicit custom health wins. JSON-RPC disables native ping by default. PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED feeds the original supervision policy rather than a new restart loop.

Node/Bun/Deno stdio/socket paths reuse Core byte framing. transport.observe is available; the old not-implemented description is obsolete. Byte observation emits once synchronously with complete frame.byteLength and borrowed detail containing frameBytes/drainMs. Inbound drainMs is 0; outbound starts at -1 and physical onWrite completion updates that same detail without a second asynchronous carrier event. Capture supplies the original frame reference; copy numeric metadata when retaining it. Whole-message content retains the original value, detail is undefined, and native-byte size is known while opaque size remains -1 without serialization. Observer failures report through Core TRANSPORT. Logical send duration is not drainMs, and Node results prove neither native Electron behavior nor a speed claim.

Web Streams byte close publishes its shared Promise before callbacks, then attempts all observers, reader.cancel, writer.abort, and physical cleanup despite failures. Cleanup rejects PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError with first cause and all errors. Writer acquisition failure releases an acquired reader lock and retains native TypeError with PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED. Node/Deno/Web byte constructors require actual resources, not authenticated-state claims.

Adapter authors can use createAdapterSocketByteIO, createAdapterChildStdio, createAdapterProcessStdio, createAdapterWebByteIO, and createAdapterProcessLaunch/Peer/Plugin. Prefer Core defineByteAdapter/defineMessageAdapter, using the original advanced SDK for complex assembly rather than duplicating framing, handshake, correlation, or lifetime state.

For ordinary foreign children use spawn:{command,args,wire:'jsonrpc',contract}, retaining normal spawn supervision. createProcessJsonRpcChannel supports an application-owned ordered byte connection. Former bridge factories converge on this entry and IProcessJsonRpcChannelOptions; bridge error constants come from rpc-contract/framing/jsonrpc. Process retains byte-close/stderr/diagnostic ownership while Core owns protocol negotiation, correlation, and cleanup.

Advanced options explicitly provide byte/peerId/target/offer/token/scheduler/wallClock/ipc/report, with optional signal/handshakeTimeoutMs. JSON-RPC handshake defaults to 10000 ms without native length-prefix framing or default ping. target is {kind:'plugin',contract} or {kind:'host',catalog}. Local contract prechecks unsupported streams; the actual callable catalog comes from remote migaia.describe, never caller-declared authority. The bridge fills codecs/auth. Optional capabilities are deadline@1, trace@1, idempotency@1 plus automatically required jsonrpc-bridge@1/runtime-api@1/batch@1/abort@1/wire-error@1.

Node launches without a shell or implicit environment inheritance, drains stderr before writing bootstrap, and never also consumes channel stdout as ordinary output. Its restart object has flat fields mode:'on-failure', maxRestarts:5, windowMs:60000, initialDelayMs:250, factor:2, maxDelayMs:30000. stop.drainTimeoutMs/stop.reapTimeoutMs both default to 5000. restart.mode is never/on-failure/always: no restart, restart on failure, or restart after every exit. A wrapper must preserve stdin/stdout: stdin first carries bootstrap and then RPC, stdout contains only protocol frames, and logs use stderr. Preserve env.inherit/env.set. A call's timeoutMs may be a nonnegative number or false: 0 expires immediately and false disables the default deadline, while a process callWallTimeMs cap may still apply. signal cancellation is cooperative and does not prove business nonexecution. idempotencyKey reuses outcomes only when the provider declared and retained them. orderKey serializes a key at the provider. cancel:'before-start' cancels unstarted work but waits for the real outcome once it has started.

Timeout, cancellation, disconnection, and unknown outcome do not prove that execution never happened. Reconcile non-idempotent writes through outcome or business state before retrying. Distinguish admission failures such as OVERLOADED/PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT and successful before-start cancellation from sent calls whose outcome is unknown.

Short connect/listen strings may be plain service names or explicit addresses. Names contain no slash/protocol and derive one endpoint from OS user and name. POSIX uses a private 0700 user directory and 0600 socket, rejecting wrong owners/permissions, symlinks, and other services' paths. Node-compatible APIs expose no peer-credential reader here; OS permissions isolate users, not applications within one user. Supply a token to distinguish those applications.

Loopback TCP, explicit Unix paths, and Windows named pipes without an adapter ACL require tokens. The same-user hello marker is public protocol data, not a secret. Supported addresses are tcp://127.0.0.1:port, tcp://[::1]:port, absolute Unix paths, and Windows named pipes, never remote-machine addresses. Port 0 lets the OS choose a port returned through listener.address.

connectTimeoutMs defaults to 5000 ms and accepts a finite nonnegative number. Only named-local rendezvous retries ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED at up-to-25-ms intervals; explicit-address dialing does not. signal cancels a pending retry with its original reason. A second same-name listener still fails PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED. Existing owner records reclaim only abandoned same-service paths.

Full connect contains kind:'connect', address/token, dial(address,signal), establish, optional offer, and native wire by default. Optional local-session supervision can set restart/startupTimeoutMs/health/stop/terminalPolicy/scheduler; it rebuilds the connection without owning or restarting the external process. Full listen contains kind:'listener', listen/address/offer/verify/createConnectionContext and optional scheduler. Each accepted session has its own labels and channel. verify returns the principal rather than trusting self-reported client identity. Invalid credentials can produce outer REMOTE_START_FAILED on the client and original PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED in the server reporter; do not blindly repeat them.

A socket listener owns listening and unhanded candidates, not sessions already transferred. close shares one Promise. Unix owner records do not guarantee native path deletion safety after external replacement: Node/libuv may unlink a successor inode installed at the old path when the original listener closes. The current path reports PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED/cause once, without repeating on later closes. Do not replace an active listener's path with another owner. The existing Darwin path budget is 104 bytes without a shorter hidden staging address.

The runtime createProcessPlugin form adds name/expose to Peer sources/provide, producing a plugin for Host.use. Host owns that installed process connection; another owner should not independently terminate it. expose defaults to no Host methods. Explicit Feature method paths are whitelisted individually: exposing math.add does not expose math.sub.

host.process request/notify/stream/group/outcome take a connection name or {name,instanceId} when exact instance selection is required. list/get expose identity, generation, health, and exit information, returning unavailable rather than invented zeros. on returns an idempotent disposer; watch is bounded async iteration. broadcast aggregates individual results without all-success guarantees. stop/kill/restart/replace require spawn ownership; connect/listen reject with CAPABILITY_CONFLICT.

IProcessPlugin.replace defaults options to {} and strategy to stop-then-start, accepting optional spec and stop-then-start/start-then-switch strategies; results carry the underlying supervisor outcome or successor plugin. Original owners retain preparation, switching, and retirement. Both Host execution budgets must be explicit under PluginHost's contract; false means unlimited rather than a default.

Root also exports parseProcessPluginDescriptor and ProcessPluginWire. A descriptor is persistent configuration data without live channels, bootstrap credentials, or authenticated state. Executable ports come from actual factories. Low-level IProcessPluginOptions deployment/host/endpointFactory/registrationOwner and convenient runtime-source options are distinct public shapes.

createProcessResilience requires scheduler/report and does not create another process supervisor. Its default idempotency store uses an owner-specific namespace. Different connections/sessions of one principal share a deduplication scope; separate owners remain isolated. identity requires a nonempty principalId, with connectionId/sessionId labels and optional processId.

Capacity, timeout, and drain options are positive safe integers; 0 does not disable them. Report times are relative to terminal entry, with the original supervisor retaining its zero-minute report. Liquidation follows the unhandled threshold rather than treating the first diagnostic as removal.

sessionOptions(identity) supplies Endpoint idempotency/limits. listenRegistrations accepts wire:'native', a real listen/address/offer, verifyToken, createConnectionContext, onCandidate, and optional serviceId/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs/signal. onCandidate returns adopt/reject. Explicit shared-instance health failure closes shared sessions before creating/replacing the target; failure keeps it fenced and reports the original reason. Per-connection mode closes only the affected session rather than replacing the shared process. Connection/rate/payload admission fails PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT before business execution. Consecutive timeouts and idle expiry close that connection without proving whole-instance failure.

Only the newest 100 committed tombstones remain. An old registration.close cannot remove a replacement generation.

registration.close stops its diagnostics/subscription without disposing an external supervisor. resilience.close releases listeners/registrations it owns, shares one allSettled cleanup Promise, and rejects cleanup failure as PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError. sections.heading: Channels, negotiation, diagnostics, and platform capability

blocks.text: IProcessByteChannel is an ordered kind:'byte' write/onData/onClose/close port whose write Promise retains backpressure. IProcessMessageChannel supplies kind:'message' send/onMessage/onClose/close. Byte createProcessTransport requires initiator+offer or responder+offer+auth; responder auth is required/verify or explicit none. Common options include peerId/report/ipc and optional signal/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs. ipc requires connectionId/sessionId/log and optionally processId, stderr, maxPendingData/maxPendingControl.

createNativeProcessOffer requires peer and optionally auth/stream/capabilities. Its direct baseline is ping/close/batch, adding stream only for stream:true. Omitted capabilities lets Runtime complete defaults from actually installed Core capabilities. Explicit lists, including [], are not widened automatically; stream:false prevents automatic stream expansion. Offer/version/codec/peer data is frozen, and Contract owns the json codec and current RpcProtocol version.

Message staticAgreement.local/peer must both use codec:'identity' with identical ordered capability lists. This validates input declarations rather than minting negotiated trust. Existing base abort/ping/close/deadline/idempotency/trace/stream/batch capabilities are directly usable; Runtime/binary extensions still require Core ACK. Missing ACK or timeout leaves actual base capabilities, visible through agreement.capabilities.

Default inbound providerLimits are maxPerPeer=64/maxGlobal=256, with rejection reasons available through onRejected. Exceeding limits produces Core OVERLOADED before execution. These differ from resilience's 32-per-session concurrency defaults. PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_MAX_FRAME_BYTES=65536 bounds the initial handshake frame; native business frames are limited to 16 MiB. Handshake and message-extension ACK deadlines default to 10000 ms. Core pending-send data/control limits default to 256/8. Manual receiveAdapterBootstrap/openProcessStdioChannel has no timer when bootstrapTimeout is omitted; automatic child discovery explicitly supplies 10000 ms. Use stream or application chunking for large values.

stderr drains from launch. Each session produces at most 32 ipc.stderr records per 1000 ms, merging excess chunks into a redacted droppedChunks summary. stdout is never a log channel. Native ping defaults to 5000-ms intervals, 2000-ms checks, and three failures before unhealthy; explicit custom health wins. JSON-RPC disables native ping by default. PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED feeds the original supervision policy rather than a new restart loop.

Node/Bun/Deno stdio/socket paths reuse Core byte framing. transport.observe is available; the old not-implemented description is obsolete. Byte observation emits once synchronously with complete frame.byteLength and borrowed detail containing frameBytes/drainMs. Inbound drainMs is 0; outbound starts at -1 and physical onWrite completion updates that same detail without a second asynchronous carrier event. Capture supplies the original frame reference; copy numeric metadata when retaining it. Whole-message content retains the original value, detail is undefined, and native-byte size is known while opaque size remains -1 without serialization. Observer failures report through Core TRANSPORT. Logical send duration is not drainMs, and Node results prove neither native Electron behavior nor a speed claim.

Web Streams byte close publishes its shared Promise before callbacks, then attempts all observers, reader.cancel, writer.abort, and physical cleanup despite failures. Cleanup rejects PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError with first cause and all errors. Writer acquisition failure releases an acquired reader lock and retains native TypeError with PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED. Node/Deno/Web byte constructors require actual resources, not authenticated-state claims.

Adapter authors can use createAdapterSocketByteIO, createAdapterChildStdio, createAdapterProcessStdio, createAdapterWebByteIO, and createAdapterProcessLaunch/Peer/Plugin. Prefer Core defineByteAdapter/defineMessageAdapter, using the original advanced SDK for complex assembly rather than duplicating framing, handshake, correlation, or lifetime state.

For ordinary foreign children use spawn:{command,args,wire:'jsonrpc',contract}, retaining normal spawn supervision. createProcessJsonRpcChannel supports an application-owned ordered byte connection. Former bridge factories converge on this entry and IProcessJsonRpcChannelOptions; bridge error constants come from rpc-contract/framing/jsonrpc. Process retains byte-close/stderr/diagnostic ownership while Core owns protocol negotiation, correlation, and cleanup.

Advanced options explicitly provide byte/peerId/target/offer/token/scheduler/wallClock/ipc/report, with optional signal/handshakeTimeoutMs. JSON-RPC handshake defaults to 10000 ms without native length-prefix framing or default ping. target is {kind:'plugin',contract} or {kind:'host',catalog}. Local contract prechecks unsupported streams; the actual callable catalog comes from remote migaia.describe, never caller-declared authority. The bridge fills codecs/auth. Optional capabilities are deadline@1, trace@1, idempotency@1 plus automatically required jsonrpc-bridge@1/runtime-api@1/batch@1/abort@1/wire-error@1.

Content-Length counts UTF-8 bytes, followed by CRLF CRLF and JSON; header≤1024 bytes, frame≤16 MiB
JSON-RPC 2.0 with id; params.hello is a JSON-stringified handshake hello containing migaia.rpc, versions, json codec, capabilities, peer, auth
reply is a JSON accept/reject string and methods lists migaia.hello/migaia.describe/migaia.invoke/migaia.cancel; accept selects shared version, currently 1.1, json codec, and shared capabilities
params.args=[]; result schemaVersion:2, self{name,instanceId}, methods; instanceId matches handshake peer.id
name, supportedModes containing only request/notify, modeSource:'declared', optional idempotent; stream is rejected
params.method and positional args array; omitted payload becomes []; id requests a result, absence means notify without a reply
Optional timeoutMs/idempotencyKey/trace, including only actually supplied values
Notification with params.id and optional reason, no acknowledgement or rollback; late results are discarded
Arrays after handshake, processed in order; replies include only id-bearing requests, with independent member failures and no reply for all-notify batches

blocks.text: Reject non-hello traffic before authentication. Invalid credentials produce reject plus wire error. stdout contains protocol only; logs use stderr. Any language can implement the peer. The former minimal Python pattern reads exact bootstrap bytes, loops over Content-Length messages, verifies hello, describes methods, dispatches invoke, and handles cancel notifications; it does not automatically implement business idempotency or cancellation. Reverse migaia.invoke is supported by the protocol but must be verified in the application's language implementation.

Payloads must be arrays, otherwise JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID. Represent integers outside ±(2^53-1) as strings. JSON encoding supports neither native streams nor transfer. Invalid framing/UTF-8/JSON or partial-frame closure terminates with JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID. Unknown/late ids are reported and discarded without disrupting other calls.

Business failures use JSON-RPC error.code/message/data.migaiaWireError, with source/code/name/message/stack and optional cause/errors. Never replace the recorded stack at the receiver. Integer JSON-RPC codes include -32700 parse, -32600 request, -32601 method, -32602 parameters, -32603 internal, and -32000 business. Semantic diagnostics still use wire source/code. Reuse Contract toJsonRpcError/fromJsonRpcError and encodeJsonRpcFrame/createJsonRpcFrameDecoder rather than another protocol implementation.

rows: Invalid header/encoding/JSON or partial closure; terminal connection
Hello omits required capabilities or extension methods
Unsupported local profile, payload, or capabilities
Stream in the local contract or remote catalog

blocks.text: Remote wire source/code is diagnostic data, not local cancellation/retry/authentication authority. Business Errors without semantic identity can restore their native type with unknown/UNKNOWN rather than invented Process codes. Non-idempotent retry still requires reconciliation or real provider-side meta.idempotencyKey deduplication.

RPC_PROCESS_ERROR_SOURCE is @migaia/rpc/process. Native synchronous spawn and Unix listener preparation/bind errors receive semantic identity on the original object, retaining native type, stack, and other OS fields while replacing errno code with the semantic code. Wrappers retain originals through cause. Do not control behavior by matching messages.

rows: Closed-channel work or resource/close-observer cleanup failure; inspect cause/errors
Facade release has begun; create another owner
Invalid governance or connection/rate/payload admission refusal
Explicit shared-instance health isolation or failed native ping
Terminal work refusal or liquidation forbidding restart
Native CPU/memory sample failure; show unavailable without altering process lifetime

blocks.text: Core call errors include DEADLINE_EXCEEDED/TimeoutError, CANCELLED/AbortError, OVERLOADED, PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND, and TRANSPORT. Remote/PluginHost/Supervision wrappers keep their own sources. Native business errors such as RangeError retain type/message/stack/cause through wire rather than becoming Process host errors.

For automatic-source failure, confirm the library launcher actually started the child. For handshake timeout, confirm bootstrap consumption, stdin reading, and protocol-only stdout. Check loopback/permissions/token for sockets. notify confirms sending only. Send large files in chunks/streams or pass an agreed path for the remote application to read. Validate descendant termination and permissions against the actual host.

options: Either complete IProcessPluginOptions with deployment, or symmetric IRuntimeProcessPluginOptions with spawn/connect/listen and provide/expose.
runtime: Loader whose `load()` returns `{ processRuntimeIO }`.
Full deployment returns IProcessPlugin, including its deployment controls; symmetric source returns the Core runtime plugin for the process slot and does not promise replace.
name: Caller-selected nonempty registration name copied when constructing the cold plugin; use the same name when addressing host.process.
Use the application-owned value shown here when configuring this connection. Omitted optional values keep their documented defaults.
contract: Application remote contract. Required and matched to name for a full deployment; optional for runtime sources, where provide normally supplies the directory.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
registrationOwner: Identifies the plugin registration that may be removed if its process cannot recover. In the full deployment form, supply the exact registration name and the Host that installs it. When failure reports remain unhandled, cleanup uses this Host to remove that registration. The name must equal options.name and the Host must provide unUse; missing or mismatched values reject configuration before process setup.
resilience: Caller-owned governance from createProcessResilience, borrowed by this plugin rather than closed with it.
Omitted: create and own a governor using the deployment scheduler and report callback.
host: Full deployment: Host port owning installation and replacement. Runtime form: the actual installing Host, needed only when exposing host control with catalog and resolvePlugin.
Omitted: allowed unless expose contains host; explicit host exposure requires host, catalog and resolvePlugin together.
endpointFactory: Endpoint factory called with the acquired channel and abort signal; mandatory for full deployments, while runtime sources can use canonical endpoint assembly.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Required in the full deployment overload; no endpoint factory is inferred.
Build the explicit full-deployment endpoint from this acquired channel; retain its pipeline and flow-control features.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
report.error: Original background failure value; preserve its source and code when present.
Nothing; the error is reported.
`defaultRpcReporter`, which reports through the default console path.
Route native process and background diagnostics to the application sink without printing credentials.
keyFactory: Key callback for automatically keyed idempotent calls in full deployments and managed runtime spawn/connect bindings. Function sources use direct Core assembly and do not consume it.
Application-issued string key for that call.
Omitted: the proxy uses defaultRpcId.

retryPort: Whole-invocation dispatch port for full deployments and managed runtime spawn/connect bindings. Function sources use the direct Core call path.
Omitted: createRemoteRetryPort uses the binding events, scheduler and reporter.
deployment: Spawn or connect deployment.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.

symbols.name: createProcessPeer
symbols.signature: export declare function createProcessPeer<TRemote = Record<never, never>>(options: IRuntimeProcessPeerOptions): Promise<IRuntimeTypedPeer<TRemote, IRuntimeFlatten<TRemote>, typeof RuntimePluginKey.process>>;
symbols.purpose: Opens a Runtime Peer to another process. Choose one source: `spawn` starts and owns a child, `connect` dials a running service, and `listen` binds an accepting endpoint. A library-launched child may omit the source to connect back. Spawn/connect/child discovery resolves after readiness; listen resolves after binding, before any client must arrive.
symbols.core:
options: See `IRuntimeProcessPeerOptions`: source, `provide`, `report` (default `defaultRpcReporter`), `token`, `verify`, `connectTimeoutMs`, `defaultTimeoutMs` (default `30000`) and Core Peer options.
An `IRuntimeTypedPeer<TRemote>`. `close()` stops new work and drains/closes under the owning runtime budget, normally `5000` ms narrowed by remaining stop time; it does not guarantee uncooperative calls finish. Spawn ownership also stops its child.
endpointFactory: Advanced synchronous invocation of an async endpoint factory with this acquired channel and native abort signal; its Promise must resolve an IRemoteServeEndpoint. Failure triggers construction rollback.
endpointFactory.channel: IRemoteChannelResources acquired by the selected platform source; ownership remains with the original construction.
endpointFactory.signal: Native construction cancellation signal supplied by the peer owner.
Promise of the endpoint assembled for this exact channel; throw or rejection preserves the original construction failure.
Omitted: the canonical runtime endpoint is assembled from the acquired channel and common options.
Keep an existing endpoint composition for the acquired process channel; use its actual codec, framer and flow-control features.
self: Application-supplied safe identity with nonempty name and instanceId; neither credentials nor arbitrary properties are published.
Omitted: the core uses RUNTIME_PEER_DEFAULT_NAME and a generated defaultRpcId; trusted platform bootstrap may supply its own identity.
Use the application-owned value shown here when configuring this connection. Omitted optional values keep their documented defaults.
provide: Application-provided local methods, descriptors or allowed runtime forwarding entries compiled into the accepted directory; methods receive the remote payload and preserve synchronous or async failures.
Omitted: this side publishes no application methods.
providerLimits: Provider admission policy forwarded to the canonical endpoint; it does not alter transport framing or acquire another provider registry.
Omitted: the original endpoint or listener admission owner supplies its standard provider limits.
authentication: Original signing, verification and optional encryption configuration installed into canonical endpoint assembly; invalid credentials reject construction before publication.
Omitted: no authentication middleware is added by these options.
probe: One IRpcProbe or an array of probes from the application, installed as endpoint-local synchronous observers without selecting a different pipeline.
Omitted: no observer is added by this field.
defaultTimeoutMs: Finite positive millisecond default for request and stream calls, validated before acquiring source resources; it does not extend the notify or group timeout scope.
30000 ms for request and stream in the original timeout scope.
contract: Optional IRemoteContract with explicit method schemas, supported modes and idempotency declarations, compiled by the original remote contract owner.
Omitted: provided method definitions supply the normal inferred runtime directory.
report: Receives background errors that no call can reject with.
report.error: Original background failure value; preserve its source and code when present.
Nothing; the error is reported.
`defaultRpcReporter`, which reports through the default console path.
Route native process and background diagnostics to the application sink without printing credentials.
keyFactory: Application key generator for automatically keyed idempotent requests on managed spawn/connect bindings. Function sources use direct Core Peer assembly and do not consume this proxy field.
Omitted: proxy paths use defaultRpcId when generating keys; direct peer call keys retain their own call-option semantics.
Managed process spawn/connect consumes this policy for declared idempotent requests. A function source uses direct Core assembly and does not consume this proxy policy.
retryPort: Whole-invocation dispatch port for managed spawn/connect bindings. Function sources use direct Core Peer assembly and do not consume this field.
Omitted: the remote proxy keeps its original retry dispatch owner; no second retry policy is installed by a direct peer.
spawn: Child to start and own: `URL`, path (relative to the main entry directory), `true` (current entry), a short object `{ entry | command, args?, wrap?, wire?, ... }`, or a full `ISpawnProcessPluginDeployment`.
Not set.
connect: Running service to dial: a name (`math-service`), `tcp://127.0.0.1:port`, a Unix path, or a full connect deployment.
listen: Address or name to accept sessions on; each session is its own connection.
token: Shared secret checked in the handshake; required for TCP, explicit socket paths and Windows pipes. Generate it per deployment and never log it.
Not set: named endpoints rely on OS user permissions.
verify: Listener side: `(auth, peer) => principalId` validating the client credential; throw to reject.
verify.auth: Portable credential from the incoming handshake, possibly undefined.
verify.peer: Handshake peer metadata supplied by the accepted transport.
Verified principal string or its Promise; throw or rejection refuses the candidate.
Not set: the `token` comparison is used.
Require an application principal for a listener rather than relying only on same-user socket permissions.
connectTimeoutMs: How long a named `connect` waits for the listener to appear.
`5000`.

Threads in the same process: use `@migaia/rpc-threads` (zero-copy transfer).
Other machines: sockets only accept local addresses.
